column1: # Ordered decisions of the resource. Choose only rows of the named procedure and evaluate in increasing n.
# The first true row with flow=stop ends the decision; no match means ordinary continuation. A next row performs its effect and continues.
# when is CEL over the observations below. No variable or outcome is an implementation API or a new public response word.

# wait: quiet sends the current WaitQuiet immediately without queue admission, replacement or capacity consumption; replaced sends 200/replaced to the former wait and frees its place before the capacity check; full sends 200/full to the new wait; admit continues to the remaining admission rules, including P/05-R154 for a busy address without client; it does not promise admission by itself.
#var unknown_since bool — since is nonzero and unknown to this resource process
#var named_identity bool — the new wait has client and the same verified CN/client as its former wait
#var former_wait bool — that former wait is currently pending
#var waiting int — pending waits after any preceding effect
#var waiter_limit int — the effective LONG_POLL_WAITERS

# retention: all facts describe the subsystem being diagnosed. term_unknown means any required term read did not answer; days_garbled means a required days is not a finite positive number; holds_unread means the holds were not read.
#var term_unknown bool — an unavailable required term read
#var days_garbled bool — an invalid required retention or alarms_retention days
#var holds_unread bool — the holds read is unavailable
# presence: use a complete readable role snapshot, with absent individual lists treated as empty; an unknown whole snapshot is governed separately by P/05-R090.
#var in_unknown bool — the slot key is in unknown
#var in_running bool — the slot key is in running
#var in_workers bool — the slot key is in workers
# object-key: run after query parsing and route selection; the facts describe the decoded key under the existing object-key grammar and loaded catalogue.
#var key_form bool — the key is UTF-8 and satisfies P/05-R007 and P/05-R109
#var door_family bool — the key belongs to an admitted door family, not a row object
#var key_exists bool — the admitted key exists among the answering servers
